works.title: Towards a Taxonomy of Software Connectors
works.authors: Nikunj R. Mehta, Nenad Medvidovic, Sandeep Phadke
works.venue: ICSE 2000 (Proceedings of the 22nd International Conference on Software Engineering), pp. 178-187
works.unresolved: UNRESOLVED: ACM DL 403 this session; title/authors/year/pages/DOI corroborated via dblp record only
works.note: The connector taxonomy paper — classifies software connectors into service categories (procedure call, event, data access, stream, linkage, distributor, arbitrator, adaptor) that TMD later canonized.

works.title: microservices.io — A Pattern Language for Microservices
works.note: Living pattern-language site verified live (pattern index confirms API Composition, API Gateway, Database per Service, Distributed Tracing, Monolithic Architecture, Transactional Outbox); companion to the Microservices Patterns book.

works.title: Design Patterns for Container-based Distributed Systems
works.venue: 8th USENIX Workshop on Hot Topics in Cloud Computing (HotCloud '16)
works.note: Names the sidecar/ambassador/adapter single-node container patterns; verified live via the authors' Google Research publication page (USENIX page 403'd).

works.title: Microservices Patterns: With Examples in Java
works.note: The canonical microservices pattern book (44 patterns incl. Health Check API and Log Aggregation); title/author/year/ISBN verified live on the Manning product page.

works.title: UNIX Network Programming, Volume 1: The Sockets Networking API, 3rd ed.
works.authors: W. Richard Stevens, Bill Fenner, Andrew M. Rudoff
works.note: Canonical sockets text whose server-design chapter defines the iterative/thread-per-connection/preforked/prethreaded server architectures; verified live on the InformIT (Pearson) product page.

works.title: DO-297 — Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA) Development Guidance and Certification Considerations
works.unresolved: UNRESOLVED: RTCA store loaded live confirms DO-297 exists as a product, but full title and 2005 issue date were not displayed; ANSI/GlobalSpec aggregator pages 403'd
works.note: The IMA certification standard contrasting integrated modular avionics with federated architectures (EUROCAE equivalent ED-124).

works.title: Enterprise Service Bus
works.unresolved: UNRESOLVED: O'Reilly publisher page 403'd this session; title/author/year/ISBN corroborated via Open Library record only
works.note: The book that defined and popularized the enterprise service bus as an integration architecture.

works.title: Autoscaling Guidance — Azure Architecture Center
works.note: Cloud-vendor canonical treatment of auto-scaling (horizontal vs vertical, metrics-driven rules, flapping); verified live; AWS Auto Scaling docs are the parallel treatment.

works.title: Reducing the Scope of Impact with Cell-Based Architecture
works.note: AWS Well-Architected guidance (publication date September 20, 2023, confirmed live) canonizing cell-based architecture as workload-level fault isolation.

works.title: ImmutableServer
works.note: The bliki entry (13 June 2013, confirmed live) naming the immutable-server/immutable-infrastructure practice; expanded in Morris's Infrastructure as Code (2016).

works.title: Kubernetes Documentation — Deployments
works.note: Official Deployment controller docs (RollingUpdate strategy, maxSurge/maxUnavailable, rollout/rollback), the de facto canonical treatment of rolling deployment; verified live.

works.title: The Art of Scalability: Scalable Web Architecture, Processes, and Organizations for the Modern Enterprise, 2nd ed.
works.authors: Martin L. Abbott, Michael T. Fisher
works.note: Origin of the AKF scale cube (X/Y/Z-axis scaling); 1st ed. 2009, 2nd ed. 2015 verified live on the InformIT (Pearson) product page.

works.title: Serverless Architectures
works.note: The canonical long-form treatment of serverless/FaaS vs BaaS; first published 2016, live page carries the revised edition dated 22 May 2018 (confirmed live).
